queryLines:
-- ds_kpi_summary (three counters: transactions, total_value, rejected_pct)
SELECT sum(txn_count) AS transactions, sum(total_amount) AS total_value,
       sum(rejected_count) AS rejected,
       round(100 * sum(rejected_count) / (sum(txn_count) + sum(rejected_count)), 3) AS rejected_pct
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_daily_kpis;

-- ds_daily_volume (stacked bar: x = txn_date, y = txn_count, color = txn_type)
SELECT date_add(DATE'2024-01-01', day - 1) AS txn_date, txn_type, txn_count, total_amount
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_daily_kpis ORDER BY txn_date;

-- ds_daily_volume (day x type grain; KPIs and type mix aggregate at query time)
SELECT date_add(DATE'2024-01-01', day - 1) AS txn_date, txn_type, txn_count, rejected_count, total_amount
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_daily_kpis;

columns.description: Percentage of transactions rejected: rejected / (accepted + rejected).

datasets.name: 49c41fc5
datasets.displayName: Fraud Risk Alert Summary by Tier and Account
queryLines:
-- ds_fraud_tiers (bar: risk_tier vs alerts, with confirmed_fraud)
SELECT risk_tier, count(*) AS alerts, sum(is_fraud_label) AS confirmed_fraud,
       round(100 * sum(is_fraud_label) / count(*), 2) AS precision_pct
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_fraud_flags GROUP BY risk_tier
ORDER BY CASE risk_tier WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

-- ds_alerts_by_day (stacked bar by tier)
SELECT date_add(DATE'2024-01-01', day - 1) AS txn_date, risk_tier, count(*) AS alerts
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_fraud_flags GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

-- ds_top_accounts (table, 20 highest-risk customers)
SELECT customer_id, city, total_sent, flagged_txns, risk_level
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.gold_customer_360
WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH' ORDER BY total_sent DESC LIMIT 20;

-- ds_rule_scores (table: precision, recall and lift per review queue)
WITH base AS (
  SELECT t.is_fraud_label AS y, f.risk_tier AS tier
  FROM northbridge.lakeflow.silver_transactions t
  LEFT JOIN northbridge.lakeflow.gold_fraud_flags f ON t.txn_id = f.txn_id),
tot AS (SELECT sum(y) AS fraud, count(*) AS n FROM base),
q AS (
  SELECT 'Top tier (HIGH)' AS queue, 1 AS ord,
         sum(CASE WHEN tier = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged,
         sum(CASE WHEN tier = 'HIGH' THEN y ELSE 0 END) AS tp FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HIGH + MEDIUM', 2,
         sum(CASE WHEN tier IN ('HIGH','MEDIUM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
         sum(CASE WHEN tier IN ('HIGH','MEDIUM') THEN y ELSE 0 END) FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'All tiers', 3,
         sum(CASE WHEN tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
         sum(CASE WHEN tier IS NOT NULL THEN y ELSE 0 END) FROM base)
SELECT queue, flagged, tp, flagged - tp AS fp,
       round(100 * tp / flagged, 2) AS precision_pct,
       round(100 * tp / fraud, 1) AS recall_pct,
       round((tp / flagged) / (fraud / n), 1) AS lift
FROM q CROSS JOIN tot ORDER BY ord;

datasets.displayName: Transaction Funnel Insights and Quality Check Summary
queryLines:
-- ds_pipeline_funnel (bar: bronze, silver, rejected row counts)
SELECT 'Bronze' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count FROM northbridge.lakeflow.bronze_transactions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Silver (clean)', count(*) FROM northbridge.lakeflow.silver_transactions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Rejected', count(*) FROM northbridge.lakeflow.silver_transactions_rejected;

-- ds_rejected_by_reason (bar)
SELECT reject_reason, count(*) AS records
FROM northbridge.lakeflow.silver_transactions_rejected GROUP BY reject_reason ORDER BY records DESC;

-- ds_dq_latest (table: latest result of each check)
SELECT check_name, status, row_count, run_ts
FROM northbridge.ops.dq_results
WHERE check_name LIKE 'lf_%'
  AND run_ts = (SELECT max(d2.run_ts) FROM northbridge.ops.dq_results d2 WHERE d2.check_name = dq_results.check_name)
ORDER BY check_name;
